# Recklessly Loved Ministries

> Christian ministry founded in 2019 by Pastors Seth & Amy Newman, dedicated to reaching the lost, serving the hurting, and showing the love of Jesus through street outreach, community events, and hands-on service.

- Website: https://www.recklesslylovedministries.org
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/RecklesslyLoved1313
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/recklesslylovedministries
- Giving: https://donorbox.org/embed/recklessly-loved-ministries

## Key facts

- Founded: 2019
- Founders: Pastors Seth & Amy Newman
- Mission: Standing in the gap between God and the lost — bringing the hope of Christ through visible acts of service
- Activities: street outreach, community feeding and relief events, evangelism, prayer ministry, radio appearances ("Be Loud" on WBVP-WMBA)
